title: hcviz per-chunk completion timeline
description: One benchmarked system's per-chunk completion times. t=0 is generation start (setup/boot excluded). All chunk coords are absolute chunk coords; the emitted race region defaults to cx,cz in [0,31] (r.0.0). Two-stage reveal (VIZ-3): chunks[].t_stage1_ms is an OPTIONAL second per-chunk series marking an earlier partial-content instant (meta.stage1_event names it; hyperchunk: 'chain' = terrain shape final, decoration pending). Design choice: one file carries both series because they come from the same capture run and must never be mixed across runs; a two-timeline input was rejected for that reason. Files without t_stage1_ms are valid unchanged and render single-stage — backward compatible by construction.

stage.description: Free-form measurement stage tag, e.g. 'hc-e6/zen5' or 'claw/5900x'

wall_s.description: Generation wall time in seconds; the panel timer freezes at this value

t_stage1_ms.description: Optional stage-1 instant (<= t_done_ms): earlier partial-content event named by meta.stage1_event. Renderers without two-stage support may ignore it.

synthetic.description: true when chunk times are generated from a pattern, not measured

source.description: Raw capture file this was converted from

event.description: Which per-chunk event t_done_ms marks (hyperchunk: complete|strict|serialize|deco|chain)

stage1_event.description: Which per-chunk event t_stage1_ms marks when present (hyperchunk: chain — noise/surface/carvers done, terrain shape final, deco pending)

pp_records.description: complete/strict events: true when per-drain pp spans (P records) were present in the capture
